task_intent: Redesign Tessera arcade games and music service connections.

mobbin.observed: The account screen groups Apps with Access separately from account and discovery settings.
mobbin.applied: Music-library permission, iPhone playback and wall delivery are distinct states; permission never masquerades as an Apple Account login or a confirmed wall connection.

mobbin.observed: Short explanatory copy sits directly beside the account setting it explains.
mobbin.applied: Denied and managed-restriction states give their own immediate explanation and route to Settings without duplicate popups.

mobbin.observed: An account identity block is distinct from account-management actions.
mobbin.applied: A clear Apple Music masthead and playback identity lead into permission-management actions. No account name is invented or requested.

mobbin.observed: Published service marks identify music connections within a unified grid.
mobbin.applied: Reuse Tessera’s existing Apple Music mark rather than draw a substitute brand symbol.

mobbin.observed: Dark service rows use a compact Apple Music icon and one clear Connect action.
mobbin.applied: A single prominent permission action, then an inline current-playback card once access is granted.

mobbin.observed: Linked music accounts use simple service identity and concise connection copy.
mobbin.applied: Plain language about what is read on this iPhone, with no developer-token or OAuth ceremony for an on-device media permission.

primary.applied: Read actual authorization before querying the media player, distinguish not determined, denied, restricted and authorized, and request permission only after the user’s button press.

A missing now-playing item is a real empty state, not proof that nothing is playing anywhere. The UI explains that only this iPhone’s system player is read; cached wall metadata is never presented as phone playback.
Use a validated catalogue identifier for specific song links; local-library items without an ID receive a generic Open Music action.
Use the existing unmodified Listen on Apple Music badge only for a specific song destination, preserve its proportions and clear space, and distinguish Apple Music from the Music app.

Verified the regional-independent https://music.apple.com/song/1146195720 route with an HTTP redirect to this canonical song. The production link builder permits only bounded ASCII numeric catalogue IDs.

implementation.permission: Production MPMediaLibrary authorization; no account password, developer token, fabricated OAuth or subscription assumption.
implementation.playback: Direct MPMusicPlayerController read while the page is active, with cached artwork scoped to the actual song identity.
implementation.wall_delivery: Only a recent matching-host, matching-song and matching-playback ACK confirms delivery. Mac-reporter success cannot claim that the wall received a song.
implementation.fixtures: DEBUG-only TESSERA_QA_APPLE_MUSIC states are explicitly marked Preview and never mutate real permissions or wall reporting.
